domain: counter-drone response at a civil airport

Hobby quadcopter with no payload.requires: a consumer aircraft and a nearby operator
Hobby quadcopter with no payload.provides: very small radar cross-section, short endurance, a live control link, no hostile intent necessarily

Modified long-range fixed wing.requires: a preprogrammed airframe with extended range
Modified long-range fixed wing.provides: hours of endurance, no control link once launched, operator far from the airfield

Swarm of coordinated small aircraft.provides: saturation of any single-target defence, simultaneous multiple tracks

Tethered surveillance aircraft.requires: a physical tether to a ground station
Tethered surveillance aircraft.provides: fixed position, continuous power, unmistakable ground origin

Radio frequency link detection.requires: the aircraft emitting a control or video link
Radio frequency link detection.provides: bearing to both aircraft and operator, useless against an autonomous airframe

Primary surveillance radar.requires: a return large enough to exceed clutter
Primary surveillance radar.provides: position and track regardless of emissions, poor against very small airframes

Electro-optical tracking.requires: daylight or thermal contrast and a cued direction
Electro-optical tracking.provides: visual identification of the airframe type, short range only

Pilot or ground staff report.provides: unstructured and unreliable position, no track

Radio frequency jamming.requires: the aircraft depending on a receivable link
Radio frequency jamming.provides: forced landing or return to home, no effect on an autonomous airframe

Kinetic interception.requires: authority to engage and a safe backdrop
Kinetic interception.provides: physical removal, debris falling on an operational airfield

Capture by net-carrying interceptor.requires: an interceptor aircraft and a stable target track
Capture by net-carrying interceptor.provides: controlled recovery of the airframe intact, one target at a time

Ground stop of all movements.provides: certainty of separation, no removal of the intruder, severe delay cost

No disruption.requires: detection without any encroachment on the movement area

Departures held.requires: an intruder near the departure path
Departures held.provides: delay only, aircraft remain on the ground

Full airport closure.requires: an intruder over the movement area
Full airport closure.provides: diversion of arrivals, cascading network delay

Aircraft damaged in flight.requires: an actual collision with an aircraft
Aircraft damaged in flight.provides: airworthiness event, potential loss of life
